questions.stem:
Given below is a list of steps Meselson and Stahl carried out in their experiment to prove that DNA replication is semi-conservative. Select the option that gives the correct sequence of steps followed by them.
(i) Bacteria transferred to a \(\text{N}^{14}\) medium and sampled every 20 minutes.
(ii) All bacteria contain hybrid DNA (\(\text{N}^{14}\) DNA and \(\text{N}^{15}\) DNA).
(iii) Bacteria grown in \(\text{N}^{15}\) medium for many generations.
(iv) All bacteria contain \(\text{N}^{15}\) DNA.
(v) Bacteria contain either all \(\text{N}^{14}\) DNA or all hybrid DNA.

questions.stem: Which of the following hormones are active during the ovulatory phase of menstrual cycle in a normal human female ?
questions._cbseVoided: (a)/ FSH and LH // (b)/ LH and Estrogen // (c)/ FSH and Estrogen
questions._flag: TRIPLE KEY: the scheme accepts (a), (b) or (c) with no note. Shipped A, which is also the first printed, because it is the letter that teaches the syllabus point: NCERT states that both LH and FSH attain a peak in the middle of the cycle and that the LH surge induces the rupture of the Graafian follicle (ovulation). The estrogen peak comes just before ovulation, which is why (b) and (c) were also credited. The solution explains all three.
